description: The district is in the fine hands of an immigration lawyer who looks out for children and calls out House Speaker Michael Madigan. Soon after being elected to her first term two years ago, Democratic state Rep. Jennifer Gong-Gershowitz, an immigration lawyer, went to work on legislation to help protect children when they must contend with our nation’s antiquated immigration system. One bill, co-sponsored […]
paid_for_by: sponsored by Illinois House Republican Leader Jim Durkin, lets parents designate a short-term guardian for their children if they are detained or deported
title: ENDORSEMENT: Jennifer Gong-Gershowitz for Illinois House in 17th District - Jennifer Gong-Gershowitz for State Rep
